title: Traffic Control
caption: Traffic Control (V)
game_text: Plays on table. “Three” on An Unusual Amount Of Fear is treated as “Four.” You lose no Force to Boonta Eve Podrace. Opponent’s retrieval from Boonta Eve Podrace may not be canceled. While you occupy three battlegrounds, Watto’s Box is suspended.
lore: Expert traffic controllers coordinate launches faster than automated launch systems. Rebel bases scramble fighters quickly during Imperial attacks.

notes: Printed base is an EFFECT; the slip turns it into a DEFENSIVE SHIELD (slip frame is the teal/red shield frame). Non-unique. Premiere card: empty expansion ring. Only a 350 px scan on the wiki. Modern remake is the Virtual Shields set only (VSh-L-trafficcontrol-pre.gif, 350 px), not a 'Virtual Set N' card, so modern=null. Year 1995 read off the 350 px scan.
